title: Complete native WOS provenance custody event
description: Transport for known original provenance kinds without a specialized canonical event. Retains the original recordKind and all original typed fields; specialized canonical kinds retain their existing routes. The recordKind enum mirrors record-kind-registry.json entries without eventLiteral. Application data is arbitrary JSON within the owning signed-64-bit/depth-128 JSON-to-CBOR subset.

id.description: Original native provenance identifier retained unchanged for correlation with the processor record and custody admission.

timestamp.description: Actual processor timestamp of the original native provenance record, retained as an RFC 3339 timestamp without reinterpretation.

actorId.description: Actual admitted actor identifier recorded by the processor for this native provenance occurrence when an actor is known.

fromState.description: Original source lifecycle state identifier recorded for this occurrence when the native event concerns a state transition.

toState.description: Original target lifecycle state identifier recorded for this occurrence when the native event concerns a state transition.

event.description: Original native event label recorded for this provenance occurrence, preserved without remapping to an invented event family.

actorType.description: Actor classification when the processor can resolve one canonically. Reserved literals are `human`, `system`, and `agent`; extension values MUST use an `x-` prefix.

lifecycleState.description: Actual lifecycle state identifier associated with this retained processor fact when no source and target transition pair applies.

definitionVersion.description: Exact workflow definition version selected by the native processor when it recorded this original provenance occurrence.

inputDigest.description: Original processor digest text for the admitted input, retained without changing its algorithm or reconstructing original bytes.

outputDigest.description: Original processor digest text for the actual output, retained without changing its algorithm or reconstructing output bytes.

canonicalEventHash.description: Trellis `canonical_event_hash` text stamped after custody admission, when present. Current Trellis service receipts use `sha256:<lowercase hex>`; older local fixtures may use bare lowercase hex.

outcome.description: Preserves maintained native TaskFailed expiry facts. The expired literal is allowed only with TaskFailed; other outcomes retain the shared provenance outcome rules.

inputs.description: Input entity references used by this activity.

items.description: Opaque or resolvable token naming an input entity this activity consumed, aligned with PROV-O `prov:used` semantics for downstream audit graph materialization.

outputs.description: Output entity references generated by this activity.

items.description: Opaque or resolvable token naming an output entity this activity produced so exporters can stitch forward references into case files or external systems.

transitionTags.description: Semantic tags copied from the firing transition when this record represents a state transition. The presence of 'determination' makes caseFileSnapshot mandatory.

items.description: One semantic transition tag copied from the Kernel transition definition, such as 'determination' for consequential decisions or 'review' for human review steps.

CaseFileSnapshot.description: Canonical case-file snapshot captured immediately before a determination-tagged transition fires. The value is the factual input to the determination; jcsCanonical and sha256 make the snapshot stable and tamper-evident for notices, appeals, and audit export.

value.description: Raw case-file JSON value observed immediately before the determination transition fires. This value may be an object, array, string, number, boolean, or null depending on the processor's case-state representation.

jcsCanonical.description: Canonical JSON string for value using JCS (RFC 8785) canonicalization semantics. Identical case-file state MUST produce byte-identical canonical strings.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of jcsCanonical. This digest links the human-readable snapshot to tamper-evident exports without requiring downstream systems to reserialize value.

ProvenanceOutcome.description: Outcome literal recorded on a Facts-tier provenance record when the processor completes (or declines to complete) an action. Open enum: the listed values are reserved across all tiers; vendor extensions MUST use an `x-` prefix to avoid future conflicts. Reserved literals currently defined: `preconditionNotSatisfied` (AI Integration §3.3.1 -- emitted when a capability precondition FEL expression evaluates to false or non-boolean, blocking agent invocation and falling through to the fallback chain) and `convergenceCapReached` (Runtime §10.3 -- emitted when continuous-mode re-evaluation hits the 100-cycle convergence cap for a single triggering mutation).

RuleReference.description: Reference to an authoritative rule applied in a decision. Mirrors `wos-workflow.schema.json#/$defs/RuleReference` (governance S6.2). Inlined at the API layer so codegen does not need a cross-schema resolver; structurally aligned so the API projection is byte-compatible with the kernel definition.

ruleId.description: Rule identifier (statute section, regulation paragraph, policy ID).

description.description: Human-readable summary of what this authoritative rule requires or prohibits.
examples: Annual renewal of eligibility required for continued benefit receipt.

citation.description: Formal citation to the authoritative source document in standard legal format.

SourceAuthority.description: Authority rank for an applied rule (governance S6.2). Closed taxonomy (ADR 0082 D-12). `type: string` matches the kernel `wos-workflow.schema.json#/$defs/RuleReference.properties.sourceAuthority` projection.

EvidenceReference.description: Reference to a piece of evidence consulted in a Reasoning-tier record. Mirrors `wos-workflow.schema.json#/$defs/EvidenceReference` (governance S6.2). At least one of `caseFieldPath` or `uri` MUST be present so the evidence is locatable; the `anyOf` constraint is a load-bearing structural pin enforced by Gate 6 byte-parity (PLN-0403 path b).

caseFieldPath.description: JSON pointer / dotted path into the case file (when `kind` is `caseField`).

uri.description: URI of the external document or record (when `kind` is `document` or `externalRecord`).

summary.description: Short human-readable description of what this evidence shows.
examples: Updated medical assessment from treating physician dated 2026-03-14.

EvidenceKind.description: Kind of evidence cited in a Reasoning-tier record (governance S6.2). Closed taxonomy. `type: string` matches the kernel `wos-workflow.schema.json#/$defs/EvidenceReference.properties.kind` projection.

CriterionResult.description: Single criterion check recorded in a Reasoning-tier record (governance S6.2).

criterion.description: Identifier or short label for the criterion that was checked.

satisfied.description: True when the criterion was satisfied by the evaluated case facts.

detail.description: Optional human-readable detail explaining the criterion evaluation result.

Counterfactual.description: Single counterfactual entry recorded in a Counterfactual-tier record (governance S6.4).

polarity.description: Whether this counterfactual is positive (would change outcome) or negative (did not affect outcome).

factor.description: Short identifier or label for the evaluated counterfactual factor.

effect.description: Human-readable description of the counterfactual effect or non-effect.
examples: If reported income were $1,500 lower, applicant would qualify.
Applicant race did not factor into the eligibility decision.

CounterfactualPolarity.description: Counterfactual polarity (governance S6.4). `positive` records controllable factors that would change the outcome; `negative` records irrelevant factors that did not affect the outcome.

ReasoningEvidence.description: Structured Reasoning-tier provenance payload linking a determination to its facts record, snapshot digest, rules, evidence, and criteria.

factsRecordRef.description: Identifier of the Facts-tier determination provenance record this reasoning entry explains.

snapshotSha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical case-file snapshot captured on the determination.

sourceRef.description: Originating task artifact or timeout transition reference that supplied this reasoning evidence.

reason.description: Human-readable narrative explanation of the determination grounded in the cited rules and facts.
examples: Application denied because submitted evidence did not satisfy the identity criterion.

CounterfactualEvidence.description: Structured Counterfactual-tier provenance payload recording positive and negative counterfactuals for a determination.

factsRecordRef.description: Identifier of the Facts-tier determination provenance record this counterfactual entry accompanies.

snapshotSha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical case-file snapshot captured on the determination.

sourceRef.description: Originating task artifact or timeout transition reference that supplied this counterfactual evidence.

AdverseNoticeProposal.description: Immutable adverse-decision notice proposal bound to the determination facts record and rendered notice template.

factsRecordRef.description: Identifier of the Facts-tier determination provenance record that produced this adverse notice proposal.

snapshotSha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical case-file snapshot captured on the determination.

templateKey.description: Declared notice template identifier used to render the adverse-decision notice proposal.

templateSha256.description: Prefixed SHA-256 digest of the canonical notice template definition used for this proposal.

machineReadable.description: Structured machine-readable notice payload assembling reasons, rules, counterfactuals, and appeal instructions.

humanReadable.description: Rendered human-readable notice text delivered to the recipient for this adverse determination.
examples: Your application was denied because the identity criterion was not satisfied.

contentSha256.description: Prefixed SHA-256 digest committing to the canonical machine-readable and human-readable proposal content.
